Hi Emily / James —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on compliance and deployment requirements: 

Summary of needs we heard
- You need to process PHI and require a BAA + SOC2 Type II evidence for vendor approval.
- Primary ask: confirm which deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem) will meet your security, audit, and data residency needs.
- You may have an internal security questionnaire and a technical deep-dive request from your infra team.

How Redwood typically maps to these needs
- Hosted API: We can execute a BAA and provide our SOC2 Type II report. Hosted is often acceptable for customers who want fast time-to-value and are comfortable with our managed controls; data is processed in TLS and segregated logical tenancy.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Offers stronger isolation (dedicated GPU pools) and is a common choice when customers want predictable throughput and additional contractual SLAs. Still within Redwood managed infra, and we can scope the BAA accordingly.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): For customers requiring strict network isolation, specific KMS/HSM key custody, or air-gapped environments. This is the path if Elara's auditors demand customer-controlled networking or on-prem processing.

Attachments I'm sharing: SOC2 Type II report (redacted summary), our standard BAA draft, and a simple VPC diagram showing the Private deployment pattern.

Proposed next steps
1) I'll share the SOC2 report and BAA draft (attached) for your legal/security review — please let me know if you need additional evidence (pen test reports, encryption at rest details, logging retention).
2) Can we schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security team + our solutions engineer to walk deployment options and the VPC diagram? I'm suggesting Tue, Mar 2 or Wed, Mar 3.
3) If Hosted looks acceptable after review, we can scope BAA sign-off + an internal security questionnaire walkthrough. If not, we'll prepare an estimated timeline and costing for Dedicated or Private deployment.

ETA: I can get answers on any SOC2 questions and confirm what we can commit to contractually (BAA terms) by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.
